edges.parent_basis:
The decree recites the act it executes: the new code of rubrics which John XXIII
approved by the apostolic letter Rubricarum instructum, given motu proprio on 25
July of this year, and which he ordered this Congregation to promulgate, the
Congregation now both promulgates and declares promulgated.

cited.basis: The same rename, at the same citation: missale-romanum-1920 34818 prints `Introitus. Gal. 6, 14.`

The Code renames the Introit, and both sides of the rename are in the same
scanned book. The Code itself, printed in the witness's front matter, heads its
own section `De antiphona ad Introitum, et Kyrie, eleison` and says at n. 427
`Ad Introitum dicitur antiphona cum versu psalmi et Gloria Patri`
(benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 4633-4637). The Palm Sunday Mass in the same book
then heads the unit `3. Antiphona ad Introitum` with the citation `Ps. 21, 20 et
22` (35155-35157), where the 1920 typical edition heads the same unit
`Introitus. Ps. 21, 20 et 22.` (missale-romanum-1920 32689).
